subject: [RFC PATCH 43/57] mm/khugepaged: check the scan budget before the work, not after

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged code to check the scan budget before performing work, rather than after. This ensures that a pass over an address space of thousands of VMAs does not exceed the allocated budget. The changes involve adding checks for the budget at the top of both loops in the collapse_scan_mm_slot function and advancing the khugepaged_scan.address pointer when skipping a VMA to prevent walking from the same place every pass.
